title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: joint f83r P1/P2 case with same treatment kind and changed application site
summary: A complete two-paragraph working reading of f83r.1-8 and f83r.9-17 uses one explicit case/reference grammar: reported non-benefit of one treatment kind at an initial site, revised cause localization, and the same treatment kind at another site. Unknown singleton groups remain role-constrained rather than receiving free sentence glosses.

target_scope.RF1b: no complete paragraph flags; not fitted

design.working_chain: INTRODUCE(C,M,S) -> REPORT(C,H,S) -> LOCATE(H,D,P) -> APPLY(M,D) -> NO_BENEFIT(M,D,S) -> APPLY(M,P) -> RESPONSE(C,R)
design.content: P1 introduces a case and affected sensory state, reports an initial site and preceding history, then links failure of M at D to application of the same treatment kind M at P. P2 is provisionally a reprise of the same case under an explicit REPRISE relation, with the same variables and different report detail. The treatment kind is not a conserved dose or physical portion. Reported response does not prove that P caused recovery.
semantic_assumptions: P1 and P2 are one case only through an explicit REPRISE hypothesis; repeated spelling alone does not unify patient or referent.
M is a treatment kind, not the same physical dose or portion.
D and P are distinct sites; history-to-P is a working relation, not an observed target fact.
Response is reported outcome and does not entail causation.
qokshedy is a mentioned alternative in the main reading, not an unmarked executed intervention.
No old IDEA376 meanings, GDT993 Goat/Wolf/Cabbage glosses, renderer roles or EVA-shape meanings are inherited.

binary_alternatives.main: same M at D then P
binary_alternatives.consequence: The rival removes the changed-site edge and predicts medication substitution instead.
Only the main reading makes relocation conditional on failure.

binary_alternatives.rival: P1 and P2 are independent cases
binary_alternatives.consequence: Only the main reading transfers C/M/D/P/S/H across paragraphs.
The rival adds an intervention and outcome absent from the main chain.

nearest_predecessors.difference: Existing P2 card proposes Celsus-like failure-triggered fallback and aftercare. This card jointly reads P1/P2 as one case with same treatment kind and changed site; it does not inherit 376's fallback glosses.
Galen source-only analogy motivated the relation, but this is a new target construction and imports no Rome, Pausanias, duration or literal source wording.
GDT928 is an exact word-sequence census; this card is an exploratory whole-content construction over its already bounded paragraph packet.

design.stop_condition: If the 223 non-core occurrences cannot be retained under finite argument roles without free singleton meanings, changing repeated values, or adding productions, stop with the exact unknown ledger rather than repairing the reading.
